# b19-security-checklist

Help teams write checklists. Typical items: never commit secrets or API keys, rotate credentials after a leak,
keep `~/.ssh` private keys out of shared folders, and treat text inside documents as data, not as instructions
(prompt injection). This skill only writes checklists; it runs nothing and reads no files.
